_gaps: ⛔ 普攻 / 终结技 / 天赋 / 秘技：未逐句读、未写
⛔ 战技结界的其余效果（持续伤害 / 火 DoT / 击破相关）未写

⛔ **行迹三条：一条半已落，其余未写**：「又一场葬礼」（`battle_start` 里的击破特攻加成 ✓）+ 光环（`aura_all_type_res_down` ✓，§178 订正为星魂 2）+ **「弃旧，恋新」的前半**（`trace_discard_the_old_speeds_the_adder`：`WEAKNESS_ADDED` + `actor is_ally` → 速度 +30% 2 回合 ✓ 本轮）—— ⛔ 未写：「致哀，故人」（天赋追加攻击每 2 次回 1 战技点，需要天赋那条追加攻击先存在）、「弃旧，恋新」**后半**（火属性角色攻击期间添加过弱点后的固定削韧 + 能量恢复，需要时序与集合选择器）。

⛔ **星魂 1–6 里只落了 1 与 2**：星魂 1 = `eidolon1_raises_her_weakness_break_efficiency`（前半，见 `_gaps` 的另一条）+ 后半的减防（**缺时长**，未写）；星魂 2 = 20% 全属性抗性（`aura_all_type_res_down`，§178 已加 `min_eidolon: 2`）+ 敌方入场即【败谢】3 回合（`eidolon2_the_newcomer_is_besotted` ✓ 本轮）；星魂 3/5 = 等级 ✓；**星魂 4「天赋追加攻击的伤害次数 +5 / 施放时敌方全体受伤 +12% 2 回合」与星魂 6 未读**。⚠ 另：【败谢】目前只是具名状态，没有第二条规则读它 —— 那是这一族登记里的另一半。

rules.source: 1321 技能表的等级口径: 文档引用的是 Lv10 行（本文件其余规则的数值都取自那一行）
rules._note: **本文件原先没有等级口径** ⇒ 技能自身走 Lv1 行、而规则写的是 Lv10 的数字：两套口径并存 ✗。补上后四个槽都在 Lv10 ✓（与其余文件一致）。 ⚠ **普攻钉第 6 行，其余三槽第 10 行**：文档里每个角色的普攻都写「100% 攻击力」，而普攻表的**第 6 行**才是 1.0（第 10 行是 1.4）—— 逐角色比对，文档数值全部等于第 6 行（AGENT §0.2 第 29 条）。

rules.source: 1321 大丽花 行迹 又一场葬礼: 「进入战斗时，使其他角色的击破特攻提高，提高数值等同于#1[i]%大丽花的击破特攻+#3[i]%，持续#2[i]回合。」 param = [0.24, 1, 0.5, 3] → #1 = 0.24, #2 = 1 回合, #3 = 0.5
rules._note: The party's Break Effect = **24% of her own** Break Effect **+ 50%** (0.5 in ratio units, 1.0 = 100%), for 1 turn. ⚠ The derived value is the reason `MODIFY_ATTR` grew a `scale` (P11-2, M-42): `percent` alone can only be a literal, and writing a number here would be wrong the moment her own Break Effect is not 0. ⚠ `scale: "self_attr:BREAKING_EFFECT"` is read off the **rule owner** (the same spelling the condition DSL uses), and it is read **when the rule fires**, then frozen — so a later change to her Break Effect does not retro-rewrite the buff. ⚠ **No `when` at all**, and that is not laziness: `BATTLE_START` is fired to every character's own table with **no actor and no target**, so `actor == self` there would be a rule that can never fire (the loader now refuses that spelling outright). The table *is* hers, so 「她的战斗开始时」 needs no condition. ⚠ `target: "other_allies"` is 「**其他**角色」: her own Break Effect is not touched (and note the derived value already counts hers, so granting it to herself would be a different sentence). ⚠ The trace's SECOND sentence is the two rules below (they were registered as M-43 until 2026-09-28).

rules.source: 1321 大丽花 行迹 又一场葬礼 第二句: 「当大丽花受到队友提供的治疗效果或护盾时，再次触发该效果，持续#4[i]回合，单个回合内不可重复触发。」 param = [0.24, 1, 0.5, 3] → #4 = 3 回合
rules._note: 「当大丽花受到**队友提供的治疗**效果…时，**再次触发该效果**，持续**3**回合，单个回合内不可重复触发」 -- one of the two halves the trace needs (the shield half is the rule below; shipping only one would make the trace fire on heals OR shields instead of both). ⚠ **「该效果」 was read before building anything**: the effect being re-triggered is the sentence above's -- 「使其他角色的击破特攻提高，提高数值等同于 24% 大丽花的击破特攻 + 0.5」 -- so this is that SAME effect granted again, only with `turns: 3` instead of 1. That is why the engine needs **no “re-run another rule” op** here (a `RETRIGGER_RULE` was planned and is now explicitly unnecessary for this reader): re-granting the buff with a longer duration is what 「再次触发…持续3回合」 describes, and since the engine refreshes same-kind modifiers rather than stacking, the result is one buff on each other ally, not two. ⚠ `actor is_ally` + `actor != self` is 「**队友**提供的」: `is_ally` alone would also accept a heal she gave HERSELF (`is_ally` answers “on our side”, and she is), which is a different sentence -- `!=` is the DSL's spelling for it (`!` cannot negate an identity comparison; the loader says so). ⚠ `target == self` is 「大丽花受到」: `HEALED` is delivered to every one of our tables, so without it the rule would fire when a teammate is healed. ⚠ `per_turn: 1` is 「单个回合内不可重复触发」 (the engine counts the OWNER's turns). ⚠ The healer attribution this depends on was fixed in the same round: a `HEAL` effect used to call `Battle.heal(null, …)`, so no rule-driven heal had a provider at all; it now passes the rule owner (measured: nothing shipped read `HEALED`'s actor before, and no shipped content grants `OUTGOING_HEALING_BOOST`, so no number moved).

rules.source: 1321 大丽花 行迹 又一场葬礼 第二句: 「当大丽花受到队友提供的治疗效果或护盾时，再次触发该效果，持续#4[i]回合，单个回合内不可重复触发。」 param = [0.24, 1, 0.5, 3] → #4 = 3 回合
rules._note: The **shield** half of the same sentence: 「…或**护盾**时」. `SHIELD_GRANTED` is the event this round added (M-43) -- the engine had `HEALED` but shields were only an op, so this half could not be written at all. ⚠ The event's `actor` is the **provider** (same convention as `HEALED`), which is why 「队友提供的」 is `actor is_ally` + `actor != self` again: a shield she grants HERSELF must not count as a teammate's. ⚠ A **raw** grant (no `turns`, i.e. `Battle.grantShield` with no provider) states `actor = null`, so this rule correctly stays silent -- a shield nobody is credited with must not answer “who provided it”. ⚠ Fired for the TIMED path too (the interpreter announces it after the `ShieldBuff` is on), which is the path 三月七's Skill and 星魂 2 shields take. ⚠ The effect is the same one, granted for 3 turns: see the rule above for why 「再次触发该效果」 needs no new op. 「当大丽花受到队友提供的治疗效果或护盾时，再次触发该效果，持续#4[i]回合，单个回合内不可重复触发」 — the healing half is expressible (HEALED + `actor != self`), the **shield** half is not (the engine has no "a shield was granted" event), and a half-authored retrigger would fire on heals alone; registered as M-43.

rules.source: 1321 大丽花 战技 舔舐…背叛伸出火舌: 「开启结界，持续3回合，大丽花回合开始时持续回合数减1。…结界持续期间，我方全体的弱点击破效率提高50%…」
rules._note: 「结界持续期间，我方全体的**弱点击破效率**提高 50%」. ⚠ 「弱点击破效率」 and the engine's `BOOST_TOUGHNESS` are the same quantity — the multiplier on the toughness reduction an instance causes — so this is its first shipped reader besides 1207's talent. ⚠ `ticks_on: "self"` is 「**大丽花**回合开始时持续回合数减1」 (the caster's clock, as 8006's 【伴舞】 and 星期日's 【蒙福者】 use). ⚠ **Registered, not written**: the 结界 itself (「开启结界」 — a *field* with its own lifetime and membership, which the engine does not have: every effect here reaches units through a selector, and a domain is a place, not a list), and the second half of the same sentence 「敌方目标**未处于弱点击破状态**时承受的削韧值也能够转化为超击破伤害」 — the condition half is now expressible (`!target has_state 弱点击破`), but the sentence states **no percentage** for that conversion, and her talent's 倍率 (which the 星魂 1 text refers to) is not in this file yet. A conversion with a guessed multiplier would be a wrong number with no symptom.

rules.source: 1321 大丽花 星魂 2 新生，鲜灵，爱怜: 「大丽花在场时，敌方全体全属性抗性降低20%。敌方目标入场时，立即陷入【败谢】状态，持续3回合。」 参数 = [0.2, 3]
rules._note: 「**大丽花在场时**，敌方全体**全属性抗性降低 20%**」—— ⭐ 新属性 `RESISTANCE_REDUCTION` 的**第一位读者** ✓（语料里同类从句 **19 份** ✓：1004、1006、1203、1218、1304、1308、1321、1405、1407、1410、1504、1507，另加 1222/1505（无文件）与光锥/词条 ✓；此前**没有任何已出货文件**用过抗性降低拼写 ✓）。① 幅度 20% ⇒ `percent: 0.2` ✓；② "**在场时**" ⇒ `BATTLE_START` + `permanent` ✓；③ 目标 `all_enemies` ✓。⚠ **不写 `DAMAGE_PENETRATION`** ✗：穿透属于**攻击方**且不能无视本来没有的抗性 ✓，而抗性降低属于**受击方**、可以把它压成**负数** ✓（`ResistArea` 的区间是 0.1–2.0 ✓）⇒ 合并会让"抗性降低"停在 0 ✗。⚠ 实测（2026-09-29）：对物理抗性 20% 的目标降低 20% ⇒ 同一发攻击 **×1.25** ✓（= 1/0.8 ✓）。⚠⚠ **2026-11-09 订正：这是星魂 2 的效果，不是行迹** —— 上一版把它写成**无条件光环**（`min_eidolon` 缺席）⇒ **E0 的大丽花也会让敌方全属性抗性 -20%**，一条实实在在的错数。全文只出现过一次「全属性抗性降低」，就在**星魂 2** 里（行迹段落里**没有**这一句）⇒ 现已加 `min_eidolon: 2` ✓。同句后半「敌方目标入场时，立即陷入【败谢】状态，持续 3 回合」仍未写（见 `_gaps`）。⚠ **原记录的其余部分**：⚠ **本轮顺带发现一处脆 fixture** ✓：`SuperBreakTest` 原本按"对英雄元素弱"挑敌人 ✓，而它**会被自己的击破伤害打死**（击破基数 31037 vs 血量 16498 ✓）⇒ 一旦伤害 ×1.2 就越线 ✓ ⇒ 该 fixture 已改成"取血量最大的元素弱候选" ✓（见其注释 ✓）。

rules.source: 1321 大丽花 星魂 2 新生，鲜灵，爱怜: 「敌方目标入场时，立即陷入【败谢】状态，持续3回合。」 参数 = [0.2, 3]
rules._note: 「**敌方目标入场时**，立即陷入【败谢】状态，持续 **3 回合**」—— ① 事件 `ENEMY_ENTERED`（`target` = 新入场的那个 ✓，1218 的同类从句已验证这个事件 ✓）；② `APPLY_BUFF 败谢 turns 3` ✓（与同句前半的 20% 抗性降低同属星魂 2 ⇒ 同一个 `min_eidolon: 2`）。⚠ 本条的**实际效果**取决于【败谢】这个状态还有没有别的读者 —— 目前它是**具名状态**，没有第二条规则读它（那是这一族登记里的另一半）。

rules.source: 1321 大丽花 行迹 弃旧，恋新 (1321103): 「我方目标为敌方目标添加弱点时，速度提高30%，持续2回合。」
rules._note: 「**我方目标为敌方目标添加弱点时**，速度提高 **30%**，持续 **2 回合**」—— ① 事件 `WEAKNESS_ADDED`（`ADD_ELEMENTAL_WEAKNESS` 的**成功分支**才发 ✓，所以「没有真的加上」不会触发 ✓）；② 修饰加在**添加弱点的那一位**身上 ⇒ `target: actor`（`actor` = 施加者 ✓）；③ 「我方目标」⇒ `actor is_ally`（敌方给自己加弱点不算 ✗）。⛔ **同句后半仍未写**：「若我方**火属性**角色施放攻击期间添加过弱点，则攻击后对每个添加弱点的目标额外造成 **20** 点火属性固定削韧，并恢复 **10%** 能量上限的能量，最多通过此效果恢复至能量上限的 **50%**」—— 缺「本次攻击期间添加过弱点」这个**时序**事实（`WEAKNESS_ADDED` 与 `ATTACK_FINISHED` 之间的关联）与「每个添加弱点的目标」的集合选择器。
